newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Sen Roth says airport fund depleting quicker.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Sen Roth says airport fund depleting quicker.

text.p: Senate Finance Committee Chairman William Roth said Friday the Airport and Airway Trust Fund may be depleted "much earlier" than originally projected.

Preliminary information from the Federal Aviation Administration showed that the unobligated balance of the trust fund would be sufficient to pay for operations including air traffic controllers until the end of this fiscal year, the Delaware Republican said in a statement.
"Funding for new contracts for airport repairs and improvements, however, will likely stop sometime in late March or early April," Roth said.
